newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain jobs growth at 2.8 pct in '97, 2.5/2.8 in 98.
newsitem.headline: Spain jobs growth at 2.8 pct in '97, 2.5/2.8 in 98.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Friday that Spanish jobs growth was rising at a 2.8 percent pace this year and should rise between 2.5 and 2.8 percent in 1998.
"We are moving at around 2.8 percent in employment this year although the last second-quarter jobs data was at 3.0 percent, Rato told a news conference after the weekly cabinet meeting.
Employment growth will be between 2.5 pct and 2.8 percent in 1998.
"I think that we can be optimistic," Rato said.
Data released earlier this week showed Spanish unemployment in the second quarter falling to 20.94 percent from 21.49 percent in the first quarter.
